verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grafana Alerting sending notifications to named integrations such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. Those are vendor and chat integrations, not documented, registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to. No item in the pack mentions a webhook contact point or event subscription mechanism, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
